additional_requirements: manic_episode is present for the majority of the total duration of the active and residual portions of the illness
delusions_and_hallucinations occur for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.

subtypes.Persecutory Delusions: The false belief that one is being harmed or monitored by other people or organizations.
subtypes.Referential Delusions: The conviction that ordinary events, remarks, or behaviors have specific relevance to oneself.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one possesses special abilities, power, or fame.
subtypes.Erotomanic Delusions: The false belief that another person is in love with or has affection for them.
subtypes.Nihilistic Delusions: A destructive or negative conviction that the world is ending or that a major catastrophe will occur.
subtypes.Somatic Delusions: The baseless conviction that there is a serious abnormality with one's body or organs.
subtypes.Jealous Delusions: The conviction that one's spouse or romantic partner is being unfaithful without sufficient evidence.

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.

subtypes.Auditory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of hearing voices or sounds when there is no actual sound.
subtypes.Visual Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of seeing people or objects that do not exist.
subtypes.Tactile Hallucinations: Experiencing the sensation of being touched or movement on the skin when there is no actual stimulus.
subtypes.Olfactory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of smelling odors that do not exist.
subtypes.Gustatory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of tasting flavors that are not actually present.

S023.name: Negative_Symptoms
S023.description: A state where emotions, motivation, speech, or social interest that should normally be present are diminished or lost.

subtypes.Diminished Emotional Expression: A state of reduced emotional expression in facial expressions, eye contact, intonation of speech, and movements.
subtypes.Avolition: A decrease in motivated self-initiated purposeful activities.
subtypes.Alogia: A state where the quantity of spontaneous speech is significantly reduced.
subtypes.Anhedonia: A decrease in the ability to experience pleasure or interest in enjoyable activities.
subtypes.Asociality: A state where interest in social activities or interpersonal relationships is significantly reduced.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

symptom.disease_info: Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) is characterized by an uninterrupted period of illness during which there is a major mood episode (manic or mixed, and often depressive as well) concurrent with symptoms that meet Criterion A for schizophrenia. There must be at least a two-week period of psychotic symptoms (such as delusions or hallucinations) without prominent mood symptoms, distinguishing it from mood disorders with psychotic features, while mood episodes are present for the majority of the total duration of the illness. The bipolar type features manic episodes and may include major depressive episodes across the course. The disorder typically leads to significant social and occupational impairment, and its course can be episodic with partial or full remissions, often complicated by stress, substance use, and nonadherence to treatment.

patient.stressor: About fifteen months ago, Scott was promoted to take on more independent buying decisions just as his company pushed aggressive growth targets tied to upcoming sneaker drops. The combination of high stakes negotiations, long hours tracking global releases, and constant social media monitoring for trends blurred his work–life boundaries, and he began staying up later and taking impulsive solo trips to chase deals and art events. Over the year, his judgment at work became increasingly erratic—overcommitting to risky inventory, missing key deadlines, and clashing with colleagues and vendors—leading to formal performance warnings and tension with his manager. When he walked out mid‑shift to "pursue a vision" for a new line and refused to return, his parents and HR persuaded him to see a psychiatrist after they realized his behavior had been escalating and interfering with basic functioning for more than a year.
patient.chief_complaint: “I feel like I’m on the verge of being a legendary visionary in fashion and everyone else is too small‑minded to keep up with me.”

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.
S019.manifestation: I know it sounds crazy to other people, but I’m completely sure that the big sneaker brands and even some of my coworkers have been tracking my phone and copying my ideas, like the whole market is secretly built around what I decide to buy, and they’re trying to shut me down before I get too powerful.

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.
S020.manifestation: Pretty often, especially late at night when I’m scrolling through release calendars, I hear this clear male voice right next to my ear giving me advice or warning me about certain people at work, even though I know I’m alone in my room and there’s nothing actually playing.

S023.name: Negative_Symptoms
S023.description: A state where emotions, motivation, speech, or social interest that should normally be present are diminished or lost.
S023.manifestation: Between these big bursts of energy, I go through stretches where I just sit on my bed staring at my shoes and can’t make myself shower, answer texts, or even care if I lose my job, and my parents say I barely react when they try to talk to me.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.
S033.manifestation: Lately my mood is all over the place—one minute I’m buzzing and laughing because I’m sure I’m about to change the whole sneaker game, and the next I’m snapping at my mom or my manager over tiny comments like they’re personally trying to crush me.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.
S034.manifestation: When I get into that zone, I can’t sit still—I’m pacing, reorganizing my entire sneaker inventory at 3 a.m., firing off nonstop emails with new buying schemes, and jumping on random buses to check out some store or art show like it’s life or death that I go right then.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).
S035.manifestation: I honestly feel like I’m this undiscovered genius of streetwear, like Virgil-level, and that these wild risks I’m taking—walking out of work, planning whole new lines in my head—are just what a true visionary has to do, and everyone who doubts me just doesn’t get how big I’m going to be.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).
S036.manifestation: Most nights I only sleep two or three hours, if at all, because I feel wired and wide awake, like sleeping would just waste time when I could be plotting collaborations or DM-ing influencers about ideas that keep pouring into my head.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.
S037.manifestation: Once I start talking about my designs or where the culture’s heading, I can’t shut up—I jump from one idea to the next so fast my parents and coworkers tell me to slow down, but it feels physically uncomfortable to pause or let anyone else get a word in.

add_requirements.psychotic_symptoms_and_manic_episode_occ: When I was on that high where I barely slept and was racing around chasing sneaker deals, that same stretch was when the voice started talking in my ear at night and I became convinced the brands and my coworkers were tracking my phone and copying my ideas.
add_requirements.manic_episode_is_present_for_the_majorit: Over this whole run since my promotion, the times where I’m amped up, barely sleeping, and nonstop scheming have taken up most of the year, with only shorter dips where I crash and go numb in between.
add_requirements.delusions_and_hallucinations_occur_for_2: Even during a couple of those dead, low periods when I was just lying in bed not caring about anything, I still heard that guy’s voice warning me about people and stayed sure the companies were watching my every move, even though I didn’t feel hyped or manic at all then.
add_requirements.functional_impairment: My buying decisions got so erratic that I blew deadlines, overordered risky stock, walked out mid‑shift, and stopped answering calls from friends or showering regularly, to the point that my boss wrote me up and my parents had to step in because I was barely keeping it together at work or at home.
add_requirements.duration: All of this—the wild highs, the crashes, and the feeling that people are tracking me—has been going on for a little over a year, basically since I got that promotion and the pressure really kicked in.
add_requirements.psychotic_symptoms_duration: The voice and the certainty that the big brands and coworkers are monitoring and copying me have been steady for most of this time, really locking in over the last several months and not fully letting up.
add_requirements.manic_episode_duration: These long stretches where I’m wired, hardly sleeping, and obsessively chasing sneaker ideas and trips have been happening on and off for almost the whole past year, more often than not.
